answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The quartz is the quoted measurement, the whisper the group it forms, and the velvet the voice that group is worth; the quartz and the whisper collapse a farm, while only a fresh velvet of hardware escapes the grouping.
